ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the opportunity stage. When it matches a stored opportunity stage, that opportunity stage is updated. Otherwise a new opportunity stage is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: Unique name of the opportunity stage.

Description.description: Administrative description of the opportunity stage.

Order.description: Position of the stage in the pipeline, lowest first.

Probability.description: Default chance, from 0 to 100, that an opportunity in this stage is won.

IsClosed.description: Whether an opportunity in this stage is closed.

IsWon.description: Whether an opportunity in this stage is won.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the opportunity stage, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

OpportunityStages.description: The opportunity stages to create or update.
